columns.name: visit_window_code
columns.reason: Protocol-defined scheduling window identifier, fixed when the visit is scheduled.

columns.name: country_code
columns.reason: Static site/participant geography known from enrolment onward.

columns.name: insurance_class
columns.reason: Administrative attribute captured at enrolment.

columns.name: arm_code
columns.reason: Treatment assignment is fixed at randomisation, before any withdrawal.

columns.name: site_retention_concern_flag
columns.reason: Subjective staff concern flag with no timestamp; typically set as the participant is disengaging, so not final at prediction time.

columns.name: consent_version
columns.reason: The consent version in force is recorded when signed and is known at prediction time.

columns.name: stratum_code
columns.reason: Randomisation stratum assigned at entry.

columns.name: unreturned_kit_count
columns.reason: Accumulates over follow-up and is only settled once the participant stops returning kits.

columns.name: imaging_protocol
columns.reason: Protocol-level imaging specification set in advance.

columns.name: travel_distance_km
columns.reason: Baseline geography of participant to site, known at enrolment.

columns.name: kit_lot
columns.reason: Lot number is recorded when the kit is dispensed.

columns.name: site_id
columns.reason: Fixed site assignment known from enrolment.

columns.name: final_diary_compliance
columns.reason: A 'final' compliance summary is only computable once participation has ended.

columns.name: language_code
columns.reason: Participant/site language recorded at enrolment.

columns.name: sponsor_region
columns.reason: Static sponsor organisational attribute.

columns.name: irb_office
columns.reason: Governing ethics office is fixed before the participant is enrolled.

columns.name: last_visit_albumin
columns.reason: Which visit counts as the 'last' one is determined by when participation stops, so the value is fixed only after the outcome.

columns.name: randomisation_block
columns.reason: Allocation block is assigned at randomisation.

columns.name: protocol_amendment
columns.reason: The amendment in force for the participant is known at the time of prediction.

columns.name: transport_support
columns.reason: Logistical support arrangement recorded when set up, normally at enrolment.

columns.name: read_vendor
columns.reason: Central reading vendor is a study set-up assignment.

columns.name: age_years
columns.reason: Demographic known at enrolment.

columns.name: ecrf_version
columns.reason: Data-capture system version in use is known at prediction time.

columns.name: prior_trial_count
columns.reason: Participant history collected at screening; does not change during this trial.

columns.name: pharmacy_code
columns.reason: Dispensing pharmacy assignment is part of site set-up.

columns.name: final_visit_window_slip
columns.reason: A 'final' visit-timing deviation is only known once the last visit has occurred.

columns.name: lab_vendor
columns.reason: Central lab assignment fixed by study set-up.

columns.name: courier_zone
columns.reason: Logistics routing attribute of the site, fixed in advance.

columns.name: storage_class
columns.reason: Sample/drug storage category defined by protocol and site set-up.

columns.name: monitor_id
columns.reason: Assigned monitoring staff member is known before and during follow-up.

columns.name: caregiver_flag
columns.reason: Baseline participant support status recorded at enrolment.

columns.name: scan_centre
columns.reason: Imaging centre assignment is fixed by site set-up.

columns.name: comorbidity_index
columns.reason: Derived from baseline medical history at enrolment.

columns.name: referral_source
columns.reason: How the participant was recruited is known before randomisation.

columns.name: baseline_symptom_burden
columns.reason: Explicitly a baseline measure, final before follow-up begins.

columns.name: device_model
columns.reason: Model of the issued device is recorded at dispensing.

columns.name: coordinator_deviation_code
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether the logged deviation predates the prediction point or is recorded as part of the participant leaving.

columns.name: query_queue
columns.reason: Reads as a data-management routing label fixed by study set-up rather than an accruing count.

columns.name: shipper_code
columns.reason: Shipping vendor assignment is part of logistics set-up.

columns.name: reminder_channel
columns.reason: Contact preference configured at enrolment.

columns.name: temperature_logger
columns.reason: Identifier of the logger device used with the kit, recorded at shipment.
